name: code_sessions_v1
purpose: Coding-agent sessions with gold answers (ledger J3): facts, replacements, lessons and situations chosen by the program, prose written by a model from a foreign family, every required fact verified in the text.
limitations: Synthetic: the sessions are what one model thinks a coding session reads like; the real held-out set (research/data/code_heldout_manifest.json) is the check on that.
Facts are template phrases the model was told to state verbatim; an extractor that copies identifiers is favoured, one that paraphrases is not - the markers include compact variants.
A fallback sentence marks where the model did not comply after three attempts; the count is in the artifact and a session with fallbacks is still in the corpus.

from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.python import PythonOperator
import logging

default_args = {
    'start_date': '2024-01-01',
    'retries': 1,
    'log_level': 'INFO'
}

def load_data():
    logging.info("Loading data...")

def check_beta_dashboard():
    # Check if the feature flag is enabled
    feature_flag = True
    if not feature_flag:
        logging.info("Beta dashboard feature is disabled.")
    else:
        logging.info("Beta dashboard feature is enabled.")

with DAG('py_data_005', default_args=default_args, schedule_interval='@daily') as dag:
    load_task = PythonOperator(task_id='load_data', python_callable=load_data)
    check_dashboard_task = PythonOperator(task_id='check_beta_dashboard', python_callable=check_beta_dashboard)
    load_task >> check_dashboard_task
EOF

lessons.desc: a model was pulled without asking; the owner's Ollama is not the project's
lessons.prevention: never ollama pull / rm / stop; use the models that are already listed

lessons.title: subprocess with shell=True and a string command

lessons.prevention: pass a list and never shell=True

lessons.desc: an argument with spaces broke the command and a quote injection was possible
lessons.prevention: subprocess.run with a list
